name: parcel-mcp-server
description: Parcel MCP connector for deliveries, tracking histories, carrier discovery, and package intake.

interface.shortDescription: Track deliveries and add packages to Parcel.
interface.longDescription: A complete connector for Parcel's external API. Read recent and active deliveries with tracking events, find carrier codes, and add packages with descriptions, language, email, or postcode details.
